hud_lab_sub: Configure factor, spectral index, sensor, year range, and frequency
resumen_desc: Integrated environmental assessment of the headwaters, glacier, and Intimpa forest in the Ampay National Sanctuary.
chart_multi_title: Multi-Criteria Comparative Dynamics (NDVI vs. NDMI vs. Monthly Precipitation)
chart_multi_sub: Monthly evolution of precipitation, canopy moisture and vegetation vigor in the selected period.
mapa_desc: Explore the Ampay Maps layers, geoportal polygons and 2017–2026 comparison plates.
veg_title: Factor 1: Vegetation Cover & Intimpa Forest Health
veg_desc: Spectral monitoring of biomass, photosynthetic vigor, and foliar water content via Sentinel-2 MSI (10m – 20m) from 2016 to 2026.
crio_desc: Integrated assessment of snow cover (NDSI), glacier area (km²), ecosystem moisture (NDMI), and water bodies (MNDWI).
temp_title: Factor 3: Land Surface Temperature (LST) & Air Temperature (T2M)
temp_desc: Multi-temporal thermal contrast between land surface (MODIS 1km Day/Night) and 2-meter air temperature (ERA5-Land 11.1km).
prec_title: Factor 4: Monthly Accumulated Precipitation & Hydrological Regime
prec_desc: Monthly hyetograph (ERA5-Land + GPM IMERG / CHIRPS) and percentage anomaly against the 2016–2026 historical mean.
prec_anom_title: Precipitation Percentage Anomaly (%) vs. Historical Mean
prec_anom_desc: Blue bars indicate rainfall surplus; red bars signal water deficit or severe dry spell in the Ampay basin.
rad_desc: Downward solar energy flux driving the high-mountain thermal and hydrological balance (ERA5-Land + MODIS MCD18A1).
glaciar_title: Factor 6: Multi-Temporal Glacier Retreat & Field Data Upload
glaciar_desc: Compare detected snow and ice coverage, including seasonal snow, between dates. You can also add field data and photos.
bd_desc: Inspect, filter by year/factor/quality, edit cells live, or add new records adhering to the 14 mandatory Google Earth Engine columns.
upload_section_title: Upload Custom Data (14-Column CSV, GeoJSON & Field Photos)
upload_csv_title: 1. Upload CSV Series (e.g., Uspaccocha / Angascocha Lagoons or Stations)
upload_csv_desc: Automatically validates the 14 mandatory columns and integrates records into charts, tables, and the GIS map.
upload_geojson_title: 2. Upload Custom GeoJSON Polygons or Points
upload_geojson_desc: Adds new forest boundaries, lagoons, or monitoring plots directly onto the Interactive GIS Map.
upload_photo_desc: Save field photos with their sector and registration date. Select a gallery image to enlarge it.
reporte_desc: Environmental bulletin with indicators, trend charts, and Mann–Kendall and Theil–Sen results.
glossary_title: Scientific glossary of spectral indices and statistical tests
glossary_sub: Equations for the satellite indices and statistical tests.
chart_export_empty: Open a section with charts to export.
chart_export_error: The chart image could not be generated.
edit_mode_enabled: Edit mode is on. You can edit the highlighted text and titles.
db_desc: Browse the 14 fields and filter by year, variable, or quality. You can also add new records.
glac_series_title: Multitemporal comparison of detected snow and ice
date_invalid: Choose a date between January 1, 2016 and November 1, 2026.
no_data_period: No data in the selected period.
map_period_note: The dates filter the map indicators. Ampay Maps layers and comparison plates show their own observation periods.
compare_desc: Reference dates are November 1, 2017 and November 1, 2026. Each plate compares October 2 through November 8 in the respective years.
compare_grid_note: Plate resampled to 250 m from coarser spatial data.
compare_pp_note: Precipitation uses CHIRPS in 2017 and ERA5-Land in 2026. Differences may reflect both the change in data source and the change in precipitation.
photo_saved: Photo saved in the fotografias folder.
photo_invalid_image: Use a valid JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
photo_too_large: The maximum size per photo is 20 MB.
photo_server: Open INICIAR_GEOPORTAL.bat to save and view registered photos.
photo_error: The server could not save the photo. Check that the fotografias folder is writable.
gee_unavailable: The server is running. Earth Engine needs valid credentials for this project.
